# R8 / ProGuard rules for classes that are referenced but absent at runtime.
#
# These are all "optional dependency" references: the library probes for a class,
# and on Android that class legitimately does not exist. R8 treats the dangling
# reference as a fatal error unless told otherwise. None of these indicate a bug.
#
# Generated by AGP's `minifyReleaseWithR8` task (see
# app/build/outputs/mapping/release/missing_rules.txt) and preserved here so the
# fix is reviewable rather than living in build output.

# Coil3 probes for the Compose PlatformContext to support non-Android targets.
# On Android the reference is never dereferenced, so the missing class is benign.
-dontwarn coil3.PlatformContext

# Rhino's JavaToJSONConverters supports JavaBean introspection on desktop JVMs.
# java.beans.* does not exist on Android, and the JSON converters are not on any
# code path CRANK uses (we only call the signature decipher helpers).
-dontwarn java.beans.BeanDescriptor
-dontwarn java.beans.BeanInfo
-dontwarn java.beans.IntrospectionException
-dontwarn java.beans.Introspector
-dontwarn java.beans.PropertyDescriptor

# Rhino also advertises itself as a javax.script engine via a META-INF/services
# entry. javax.script.ScriptEngineFactory is absent on Android, so the service
# file is an unresolvable reference. R8 warns but does not fail; the rule keeps
# the build output clean so a real problem is visible.
-dontwarn javax.script.ScriptEngineFactory

# Ktor's debugger detector is a JVM-only convenience check.
# java.lang.management does not exist on Android.
-dontwarn java.lang.management.ManagementFactory
-dontwarn java.lang.management.RuntimeMXBean
